scope: shared full Elm client source closure; excludes external toolchain and dependency cache
archiveFormat: POSIX pax tar.gz; normalized owner, group, mtime, path order, and gzip timestamp

package.selection: lexicographically last esbuild@ entry, matching tools/build-elm-site.mjs

toolProvenance.minificationSelection: build-elm-site.mjs selects lexicographically last vendored esbuild entry; output mode/warnings require a build receipt
toolProvenance.limitation: Missing tool hashes are represented as incomplete provenance; source capture can still be used as a narrower observation.
